August Attend the Work-Study Job Fair. Release of financial aid for fall begins on or around the first day of class. October Early spring semester registration for continuing and readmitted students. The Office of Accounting will mail fee bills to the designated local or permanent address. November Continuing and Transfer Student Scholarship Application available for next academic year. December Spring fee bill due for students who have already registered. January January 1 - FAFSA and Renewal FAFSA are available to complete for upcoming academic year. Registration for new and readmitted students not yet registered. The Office of Accounting will not mail fee bills. Release of financial aid for spring begins on or around the first day of class. February February 15 - FAFSA priority deadline for summer. March March 31 - FAFSA priority deadline for fall. Watch the mail for your Student Aid Report (SAR). If selected for verification , send the required documents to OSFS . April April 1 - Continuing and Transfer Student Scholarship Application deadline. Watch for your Financial Aid Notification or E-FAN . Activate your FAN or fill out your EFAN to accept, decline, or reduce your awards. Division of Housing & Food Service contract offers begin for non-first-time freshmen (including transfer and CAP students). May Finalize on-campus housing choices with the Division of Housing & Food Service . Look for a summer job. June Financial aid release for summer begins on or around the first day of class. July Complete all requirements necessary to receive your fall financial aid. August Financial aid release for fall begins on or around the first day of class.
